description: This file manages plugin runtime dependencies for a software project. It includes functions for reading and writing JSON files, handling filesystem operations like copying, renaming, and removing directories, managing dependencies via npm, and staging or installing dependencies for bundled plugins, with support for retries and version checks.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the given path.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Writes a JavaScript object as JSON to the specified file path.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes the specified path if it exists, recursively if it's a directory.

methods.name: makeTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a prefix in the system temp directory.

methods.name: sanitizeTempPrefixSegment
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be used as a temp directory prefix segment.

methods.name: replaceDir
methods.description: Renames or copies source directory to target directory, replacing it if it exists.

methods.name: dependencyNodeModulesPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a dependency in node_modules.

methods.name: readInstalledDependencyVersion
methods.description: Reads the installed version of a dependency from its package.json.

methods.name: dependencyVersionSatisfied
methods.description: Checks if an installed version satisfies a specified semver range.

methods.name: collectInstalledRuntimeClosure
methods.description: Resolves the full closure of installed dependencies meeting specific version specs.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDirs
methods.description: Lists directories of bundled plugins with package.json files under 'dist/extensions'.

methods.name: hasRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Checks if a package.json has runtime dependencies.

methods.name: shouldStageRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Checks if runtime dependencies should be staged based on openclaw bundling config.

methods.name: sanitizeBundledManifestForRuntimeInstall
methods.description: Removes openclaw dependencies from the plugin's package.json to prepare for runtime install.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeDepsStampPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the runtime deps stamp file within a plugin directory.

methods.name: createRuntimeDepsFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a SHA256 hash fingerprint of a package.json for dependency consistency.

methods.name: readRuntimeDepsStamp
methods.description: Reads the runtime dependencies stamp file if it exists.

methods.name: stageInstalledRootRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Stages runtime dependencies by copying node_modules into a temporary directory and replacing the original.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Installs runtime dependencies for a plugin via npm, staging them in process.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDepsWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to install runtime dependencies multiple times with retries on failure.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Main function to stage or install runtime dependencies for all bundled plugins based on configuration.
